_comment: What marks an observed row as a Flock Safety camera. Both lists ship EMPTY on
purpose: no rule has been verified against a real observation yet, and guessing
one would put a surveillance-camera marker on a resident's access point.
ssid_patterns: case-insensitive substrings matched against the SSID / device name.
oui_prefixes:  MAC address prefixes, lower case and colon-separated, matched
against the start of the canonical BSSID (e.g. "a4:da:22").
A matching row is published to data/flock.json IN ADDITION to the database its
Type selects, so adding a rule never changes what the main map means. Delete a
rule and the marker stops being re-added; existing records are removed by hand,
the same way as a removal request (docs/removals.md).
